title: On Parallel and Batch-Cutting Strategies for Norm-Minimization-Based Convex Vector Optimization
summary: We develop parallel and batch-cutting variants of the norm-minimization-based outer approximation algorithm for convex vector optimization. The standard algorithm solves $N_k$ independent subproblems at each iteration~$k$ to evaluate all vertices of the current polyhedral approximation, but processes only the single best cut. We propose two improvements. First, we parallelize the \revise{subproblem evaluations} across $\nw$ workers, reducing per-iteration wall-clock time.
